beats.name: Guard
beats.prompt: A person raises both fists to the chin in a boxing guard and bounces lightly on the balls of their feet.

beats.name: Flinch
beats.prompt: A person in a boxing guard flinches, ducking the head and pulling it back sharply, then settles back into guard.

beats.name: Glancing blow
beats.prompt: A person in a boxing guard is clipped on the jaw by a punch, the head snaps to the side, and they shake it off and return to guard.

beats.name: Body blow
beats.prompt: A person in a boxing guard is punched hard in the stomach, doubles over wincing in pain, then slowly straightens up.

beats.name: Heavy blow
beats.prompt: A person is hit hard in the face, the head snaps back, and they stagger backward two steps before catching their balance.

beats.name: Knockout
beats.prompt: A person is knocked out by a punch to the jaw, goes limp and collapses backward onto the ground, lying still.
